q: Which treatment left the most bacteria?
How many fewer colonies grew after washing with soap for 20 s than after water only?
Calculate the percentage drop in colonies from "not washed" to "soap for 20 s".
Use the data to write advice for younger students, and explain why the plates were kept sealed and never opened.

Wash with soap for at least 20 seconds: water alone removes only about a quarter of bacteria. The plates stay sealed because the colonies could include harmful bacteria, and opening them could spread them.
